title: Supply of Diesel Fuel S500 for Generator Refueling at U.S. Consulate São Paulo
agency: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.CONSULATE GENERAL SAO PAULO
description_text: The U.S. Consulate General São Paulo located at 700 Henri Dunant Street (ZIP Code 04709-110) is soliciting quotations for a one-time delivery of approximately 48,000 liters of Diesel Fuel S500 for generator refueling.
